text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from an
outing with
Kitasan Black, we stop by
the mall to do some
shopping.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I knew it! It is! Hi, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If it isn't Kitasan! Hey, if ya got some
time, swing
by and visit me later!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm helpin' out with a food stall at a
special
event! Do you guys have
anything in particular ya
reeeally like?
choice_data_list: You told me to stop by, but what a...
You told me to stop by, but what a...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Good question! Honestly, I love all food
stall
goodies...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, wait! I really like honeycomb toffee!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho, not one for the fancy stuff,
are ya?
You sure ya wouldn't prefer a
kebab or crepe?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I've loved it ever since I was a kid!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see! If ya like it that much, then
I'll
graciously get ya some, my treat!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, would you really? Thank you! I'll
savor
every bite!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmm, it tastes so good!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I used to share my food with my
little
brothers in the park like this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It is! Whenever we went to a festival, our
parents
would always buy us something
to eat!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I loved eating honeycomb toffee
together with
my dad, mom, and
brothers...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Heck, I even threw a tantrum or two
about it. I
just didn't understand why
they didn't sell it on
non-festival days.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's when one of my dad's pupils told
me how
easy it is to make toffee. But
when I made it...

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
How come my toffee's not as fun as the
toffee at
festivals?

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna eat the same kinda toffee we
get at
festivals!

text_block_list.name: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Well, Li'l Miss, that's because...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"A food's flavor changes depending on
where you
eat it and who you eat it
with." ...That's what he
told me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's when I realized what I really liked
was
sharing the candy with my family
during festival
days...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eating with the people I love during the
festivals I
love was what made it special!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eating with the people I love during the
festivals I
love was what made it special!
choice_data_list: You really love your dad and every...
You really love your dad and every...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It does! And all those special memories
are very
precious to me. But you know...
choice_data_list: You really love your dad and every...
You really love your dad and every...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'll ever forget the
taste of
the
honeycomb toffee I had today
either.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hanging out with you and telling you
about my
childhood, well... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The sweetness I tasted long ago filled
me with excitement, but the sweetness I
tasted today has
filled my chest with
warmth!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we should have honeycomb
toffee again
sometime! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how we ended up with a new
taste that
will surely remind us both of
happy memories for
a long time to come.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I sure do!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My family is front and center in every
one of my
fond memories!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's too hard to go to a festival together
as a
family nowadays, but I sure wanna
eat
honeycomb toffee with them again...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I could, but I think my family would
agree that it's
just not the same as
eating together at a
festival...
choice_data_list: Why don't you make it for them?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Having honeycomb toffee
together with my family after so long
might create a new
and special taste to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll need to practice a lot so I can make
the
ultimate toffee!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then let's start by making
around thirty
portions!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you count my dad's apprentices,
my
family is well over twenty people!
Now let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After we get back to the academy,
Kitasan Black
and I churn out a huge
amount of honeycomb
toffee together.
